result.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
result.summary: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Library of Layers（LoL）：推理时从共享的 transformer 块库中动态编排层的执行顺序，用层库大小这一超参数统一稠密、深度循环与 MoE 三类架构的参数/FLOPs 权衡，并在文本预训练、数独与迷宫、多语言及安全数据上分析路由顺序与策略、语种的关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本工作、未涉及视觉或多模态输入，但把深度循环推广为可学习的层序与计算图选择，并发现不同路由顺序对应不同解题策略且可被干预，可能为 LVR 中 loop/深度循环的收益成本权衡与路由可解释性提供借鉴线索，可供核查。
